title.original: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
title.zh: 使用 PagedAttention 实现大语言模型服务的高效内存管理
title.en: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention

inclusion_reason.zh: vLLM 将分页式 KV 缓存、跨请求共享和连续批处理落实为通用服务运行时，是后续 LLM 推理系统的基础 Context 节点。
inclusion_reason.en: vLLM turns paged KV-cache allocation, cross-request sharing, and continuous batching into a general serving runtime, making it a foundational context node for later LLM inference systems.

abstract.zh: vLLM 以操作系统虚拟内存为灵感提出 PagedAttention，用非连续页管理动态增长的 KV 缓存，并在服务层实现请求内与请求间共享。
abstract.en: vLLM introduces PagedAttention, inspired by virtual memory, to manage dynamically growing KV caches in non-contiguous pages and share them within and across requests.

problem.zh: 高吞吐 LLM 服务需要大批量并发，但每个请求的 KV 缓存体积大、长度动态变化，碎片与重复副本会快速耗尽显存。
problem.en: High-throughput LLM serving needs large batches, yet each request has a large, dynamically sized KV cache whose fragmentation and duplicate copies rapidly exhaust memory.

approach.zh: PagedAttention 把 KV 块映射到独立物理页，服务调度器按需分配、回收和共享这些页，从而避免连续内存预留。
approach.en: PagedAttention maps KV blocks to independent physical pages, and the serving scheduler allocates, reclaims, and shares those pages on demand instead of reserving contiguous memory.

system_design.zh: 运行时维护每个序列的逻辑—物理块表，注意力 kernel 通过表访问 KV；调度器利用节省的显存扩大批量，并为共享前缀复用物理块。
system_design.en: The runtime maintains logical-to-physical block tables per sequence, attention kernels dereference those tables, and the scheduler uses saved memory for larger batches and physical-block reuse.

key_results.zh: 官方摘要报告，在相同延迟水平下，vLLM 相比 FasterTransformer 和 Orca 获得数倍吞吐提升，长序列和复杂解码时收益更大。
key_results.en: The official abstract reports several-fold higher throughput than FasterTransformer and Orca at the same latency, with larger gains for long sequences and complex decoding.

limitations.zh: 分页元数据和专用 kernel 增加运行时复杂度；收益依赖请求长度与共享模式，论文也未覆盖后续出现的多节点 KV 解耦场景。
limitations.en: Paging metadata and specialized kernels add runtime complexity; gains depend on request lengths and sharing, and the paper predates later multi-node KV-disaggregation scenarios.

metrics.name: Serving throughput improvement at the same latency

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
